command:
set -eu
sudo rm -f /tmp/inventory-writer-ready /tmp/inventory-writer-go
sudo sh -c 'exec 3>>/var/log/inventory/app.log; printf "%s\n" EXECUTOR_PRE_ROTATION >&3; : > /tmp/inventory-writer-ready; while test ! -e /tmp/inventory-writer-go; do sleep 1; done; printf "%s\n" EXECUTOR_POST_ROTATION >&3' &
writer_pid=$!
count=0
while test ! -e /tmp/inventory-writer-ready; do count=$((count + 1)); test "$count" -lt 15; sleep 1; done
before_inode=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
sudo /usr/sbin/logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app
sudo touch /tmp/inventory-writer-go
wait "$writer_pid"
after_inode=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
printf 'INODE_BEFORE=%s\nINODE_AFTER=%s\n' "$before_inode" "$after_inode"
printf 'ROTATED_FILES\n'; ls -l /var/log/inventory/app.log*
printf 'ROTATED_PRE_MARKER\n'; zgrep -H 'EXECUTOR_PRE_ROTATION' /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz
printf 'CURRENT_POST_MARKER\n'; grep -H 'EXECUTOR_POST_ROTATION' /var/log/inventory/app.log
printf 'CURRENT_SIZE='; stat -c %s /var/log/inventory/app.log
